description: This CMake script defines the function 'GetExternalCode', which automates the process of fetching external code repositories (currently only Git). It handles cloning a repository, checking out a specific version, and optionally forcing re-cloning. The script manages external dependencies during the build configuration phase.

methods.name: GetExternalCode
methods.description: A function that clones a Git repository, checks out a specific version, and manages repository location and re-cloning based on parameters.
